ns2:section.sectionText: A course on the engineering process fostering the identification of needs and potential engineering solutions. This course will encapsulate the ideation and problem identification aspects of engineering senior design, and is anticipated to facilitate student innovation. Students taking ECE445 senior design may use this course one to two semesters before taking ECE445 to identify a suitable project for the course, to build a team, and to explore the feasibility and potential solution space for the selected project area.
